text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Hayahide was super fast.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, her fighting spirit was 
incredible. On the final stretch, it was 
like no one else stood a chance..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But... my spirit isn't gonna lose to 
anyone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I have to work way, way harder so we can 
hype up the greatest race ever!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Running the ultimate race to fire 
everyone up. I believe she said something 
like that before the race, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hayahide! That was an incredible 
run~~! The crowd's cheering was amazing 
too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
From now on, as rivals, we'll give the 
crowd the ultimate—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket. I... cannot see you as a rival as 
you are right now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Taishin would probably say the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh... N-No, wait, wait, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why?! We've been racing against each other 
this whole time! We even went all-out 
against each other in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Back at the Derby, we were 
rivals, without a shadow of a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But—now is different.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, it's different... I-I 
was just as fired up today as I was back 
at the Derby, and it was the best—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's not the same. It's entirely 
different now, Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't even noticed that 
difference... then I truly can't call you 
my rival anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What I seek in a race is different from 
what you call the 'ultimate race.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you should think once more about 
why you run in races?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hayahide...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Am I not a rival anymore...? What am 
I... running for...?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want to... run the ultimate race 
alongside my rivals and get the crowd all 
fired up...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Am I making a mistake...?

Her shoulders trembling slightly, Winning 
Ticket muttered under her breath.
